submitted.rationale: The best photocurrent among the three measured samples was 7.58 µA at V0.86Zr0.14. The V-rich end, where V2O5-like phases absorb light at 3.22 eV, was much stronger than V0.67Zr0.33 near ZrV2O7 (0.23 µA). V0.88 (3.73 µA) was lower than V0.86, so the peak is probably close to the 0.83–0.86 range.
